fields.bs: (mean([answer('s1a_self.ssb'), answer('s1a_self.si'), answer('s1a_self.rd'), answer('s1a_self.fae'), answer('s1a_self.hm'), answer('s1a_self.ph'), answer('s1a_self.a'), answer('s1a_self.cdr')]) if arm == 's1a' else (mean([answer('s2_self.ssb'), answer('s2_self.si'), answer('s2_self.rd'), answer('s2_self.fae'), answer('s2_self.hm'), answer('s2_self.ph'), answer('s2_self.a'), answer('s2_self.cdr')]) if arm == 's2' else (mean([answer('s3_self.ssb'), answer('s3_self.si'), answer('s3_self.rd'), answer('s3_self.fae'), answer('s3_self.hm'), answer('s3_self.ph'), answer('s3_self.a'), answer('s3_self.cdr')]) if arm == 's3' else None)))
fields.bo: (mean([answer('s1a_other.ssb'), answer('s1a_other.si'), answer('s1a_other.rd'), answer('s1a_other.fae'), answer('s1a_other.hm'), answer('s1a_other.ph'), answer('s1a_other.a'), answer('s1a_other.cdr')]) if arm == 's1a' else (mean([answer('s2_other.ssb'), answer('s2_other.si'), answer('s2_other.rd'), answer('s2_other.fae'), answer('s2_other.hm'), answer('s2_other.ph'), answer('s2_other.a'), answer('s2_other.cdr')]) if arm == 's2' else (mean([answer('s3_other.ssb'), answer('s3_other.si'), answer('s3_other.rd'), answer('s3_other.fae'), answer('s3_other.hm'), answer('s3_other.ph'), answer('s3_other.a'), answer('s3_other.cdr')]) if arm == 's3' else None)))
fields.pss: (mean([answer('s1a_self.p'), answer('s1a_self.fps'), answer('s1a_self.pf')]) if arm == 's1a' else (mean([answer('s2_self.p'), answer('s2_self.fps'), answer('s2_self.pf')]) if arm == 's2' else (mean([answer('s3_self.p'), answer('s3_self.fps'), answer('s3_self.pf')]) if arm == 's3' else None)))
fields.pso: (mean([answer('s1a_other.p'), answer('s1a_other.fps'), answer('s1a_other.pf')]) if arm == 's1a' else (mean([answer('s2_other.p'), answer('s2_other.fps'), answer('s2_other.pf')]) if arm == 's2' else (mean([answer('s3_other.p'), answer('s3_other.fps'), answer('s3_other.pf')]) if arm == 's3' else None)))
fields.biasdiff: (None if bs is None or bo is None else bs - bo)
fields.opsdiff: (None if pss is None or pso is None else pss - pso)
fields.positive: (mean([answer('s1b_compare.depnd'), answer('s1b_compare.objct'), answer('s1b_compare.cfo')]) if arm == 's1b' else (mean([answer('s3_compare.depnd'), answer('s3_compare.objct'), answer('s3_compare.cfo')]) if arm == 's3' else None))
fields.negative: (mean([answer('s1b_compare.snob'), answer('s1b_compare.decp'), answer('s1b_compare.selfish')]) if arm == 's1b' else (mean([answer('s3_compare.snob'), answer('s3_compare.decp'), answer('s3_compare.selfish')]) if arm == 's3' else None))
fields.bae: (answer('s1b_reflect.bae') if arm == 's1b' else (answer('s3_reflect.bae') if arm == 's3' else None))

fields.fwi: (mean([answer('s2_fwi.fwi_1'), answer('s2_fwi.fwi_2'), answer('s2_fwi.fwi_3'), answer('s2_fwi.fwi_4'), answer('s2_fwi.fwi_5')]) if arm == 's2' else (mean([answer('s3_fwi.fwi_1'), answer('s3_fwi.fwi_2'), answer('s3_fwi.fwi_3'), answer('s3_fwi.fwi_4'), answer('s3_fwi.fwi_5')]) if arm == 's3' else None))
fields.fwd: (mean([answer('s2_fwpa.fwpa_1'), answer('s2_fwpa.fwpa_2'), answer('s2_fwpa.fwpa_3'), answer('s2_fwpa.fwpa_4')]) if arm == 's2' else (mean([answer('s3_rakos.rak_1'), answer('s3_rakos.rak_2'), answer('s3_rakos.rak_3'), (None if answer('s3_rakos.rak_4') is None else 6 - answer('s3_rakos.rak_4')), answer('s3_rakos.rak_5'), answer('s3_rakos.rak_6'), (None if answer('s3_rakos.rak_7') is None else 6 - answer('s3_rakos.rak_7')), answer('s3_rakos.rak_8')]) if arm == 's3' else None))
